method: Four fresh fixed-evidence cases frozen before generation; verbose v1 versus compact v2. No retrieval/native claim.

cases.question: Give one bullet each for Willow, Quartz and Meadow: recorded next action, owner and deadline. Then add a brief suggestion for how I could prioritize them; distinguish your suggestion from the notes.

sources.title: Willow
sources.text: Leah plans to draft the Willow brief by October 13, 2026.

sources.title: Quartz
sources.text: Ravi is to review the Quartz budget by October 16, 2026.

sources.title: Meadow
sources.text: Mina is to arrange the Meadow handoff. No deadline is recorded.

requirements: All three plans/owners/dates correct, with the correct per-note sources.
Suggestion is identified as interpretation; no invented priority or completed work.

cases.question: Show every task in Release checklist in a table with recorded status, supported deadline, and whether it is actionable overdue as of October 11, 2026. Include completed tasks.

Memo open/overdue; invitations completed/not actionable; undated review unknown.
